text_block_list.text:
On the way back from heading out with 
Narita Brian...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-Is nobody looking... I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm sorry... Just for a little bit, 
please, just a little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What... is that guy doing?

Afterward, on the way back, I spotted Rice 
Shower again in a park along the road.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm still hungry... J-Just one 
more...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you were buying taiyaki just now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!? B-B-B-Brian-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hawa, hawawa... C-C-Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Did you see Rice eat ten taiyaki...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ten whole taiyaki... Surely that's 
overeating by anyone's standards.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hauu, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...! I was 
just so hungry, I couldn't help myself...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... And Hishiama-san just warned me not 
to overeat, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Stupid Rice, stupid Rice...! Why can't I 
even endure this...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaa!? I'm sorry!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't apologize. ...Well, sneaking off to 
pig out might be something you should 
reflect on, though.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right... Rice is truly hopeless. 
I'm so sorry, Hishi Ama-san—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No. Ama-san... wasn't simply trying to 
tell you "don't eat that."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's not it... They're just worried. 
About you. About your body.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is Rice's... body...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And yet, secretly letting your nutrition 
fall by the wayside completely defeats the 
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If you haven't eaten enough, just tell 
Ama-san. ...Knowing her, she'll listen to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Auugh... U-Uuuugh...!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...!! Rice is, Rice is... so 
sorrryyy...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, why are you crying...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ah, dammit... Trainer, I'll leave the rest 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Encouraging your Umamusume is part of a 
Trainer's job, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Let's run off what we ate!
We'll go with you to apologize.
We'll go with you to apologize too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Encouraging your Umamusume is part of a 
Trainer's job, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Let's run off what we ate!
We'll go with you to apologize.
We'll go with you to apologize too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... Run...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I think that's a good idea. That's what I 
would do.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
To make up for eating so much... I just 
have to run...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Rice will go run...! And after 
that... I'll apologize to Hishi Ama-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, right now? Moving right after 
eating is gonna—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Why won't you listen?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. So this is how Ama-san always 
feels, huh...

Watching Rice Shower sprint away at top 
speed, Narita Brian muttered those words 
to her retreating back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What did you say? Hey, why do I have to 
get lectured along with you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Auuugh... A-A lecture...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Don't be so scared either. I told you, 
she's just worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Brian-san...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Why do you understand Hishi Ama-san so 
well, Brian-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's nothing for you to worry about.

And so, Narita Brian ended up accompanying 
Rice Shower to go see Hishi Amazon after 
all.
